goal: Stop using one chat subscription for everything and route steps across reasoning, workhorse, fast subagent, and open-weight tiers.
body: Most organizations overpay on routine tasks while under-specifying high-stakes reasoning. subject: Day 2: Productive Friction & Interview-First Skills Over Ad-Hoc Prompting
goal: Eliminate sycophantic hallucinations by making AI interview and prod the user for missing constraints before generating.
body: Twelve-word ad-hoc prompts force models to guess 85% of your business rules. Flip the loop with Productive Friction: engineer Socratic SKILL.md folders and intake gates that ask 3 to 5 targeted questions, extract unwritten SOPs from your team, and verify constraints before drafting. Test the live interactive comparison at https://agenticarchitect.ai/courses.

subject: Day 3: Privacy Boundaries, Local Cowork Folders & Scoped Permissions
goal: Classify Green, Amber, and Red company data across Enterprise Cloud, Zero-Retention APIs, and Private Open-Weight Rigs.
body: Saying 'we opted out of training' is only 20% of data governance. Learn when unified Enterprise workspaces suffice, when regulated Legal/Finance/Healthcare workflows require Zero-Data-Retention (ZDR) or 3P VPC gateways, and why external actions stay strictly at Level-2 Draft-First approval.
